title: WF03 Stage11 releasefix: silent integration DB cleanup failure could leak stale fixture data and trigger DuplicateNameVersion cascades
summary: Rework1 confirmed the Stage 11 releasefix path no longer stalls at cleanup. The perceived stall was caused by non-supervised overlapping integration runners and non-deterministic capture strategy. A supervised integration task script was added to enforce a single local run context and persist deterministic completion output with explicit exit code evidence.

root_cause.details: Repeated retries launched overlapping zig/test processes with no enforced single-run supervision and no deterministic completion marker, making runs appear hung even when test execution was still active.

changes: .vscode/run-zig-test-integration.ps1: terminate stale zig/test processes before a new run to prevent overlapping runners.

.vscode/run-zig-test-integration.ps1: run zig build test-integration --summary all and write deterministic completion evidence to tests/reports/zig-test-integration-supervised-latest.log including INTEGRATION_EXIT_CODE.

commands.evidence: Command produced deterministic completion summary and explicit INTEGRATION_EXIT_CODE in tests/reports/zig-test-integration-supervised-latest.log.
No stall reproduced; run completed with Build Summary and explicit failing-test counts (342 pass, 7 skip, 6 fail).

prevention: Always execute integration reruns via the supervised script instead of ad-hoc overlapping terminal retries.
Persist deterministic completion markers (INTEGRATION_EXIT_CODE) in workspace evidence logs for release-gate audits.
Treat repeated no-output windows as potentially active execution; verify process state before classifying as a stall.
